script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: The Perfect Team

INT. GYM - DAY

JIM (30s, athletic, determined) sits on a bench, watching a group of young kids play basketball. He scans the room, taking in every detail: the way they laugh and play, the encouragement they offer each other. He closes his eyes, lost in thought.

JIM (V.O.)
(whispering)
I used to be part of something like this.

INT. JIM'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jim, hunched over a coffee table littered with papers and pictures, reminisces about his past. We see flashbacks of him playing on a competitive basketball team, winning games, and celebrating with friends.

INT. JIM'S APARTMENT - PRESENT

Jim snaps back to reality and tosses the photographs into a box. He looks around the empty room, feeling a pang of loneliness.

JIM (V.O.)
But that was a long time ago. I've let life get in the way.

EXT. LOCAL PARK - DAY

Jim walks through the park, passing by various sports fields, a soccer game, a softball game, and eventually, a pick-up basketball game. He hesitates for a moment before joining in.

INT. GYM - EVENING

Jim, now wearing his basketball sneakers, plays with the group of regulars. They introduce themselves: TREVOR (early 30s, funny, energetic), JESSICA (late 20s, competitive, focused), MIKE (early 30s, wise, supportive), and RACHEL (early 30s, quiet, steady).

TREVOR
(grinning)
Welcome to our little crew!

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

After the game, Jim and the team gather for coffee and conversation. They share stories about their lives, their struggles, and their dreams. Jim realizes that, despite their differences, they all share a common bond: the love of basketball and the desire to connect with others.

JIM
(looking around the table)
I've missed this... this camaraderie.

JESSICA
(smiling)
We're glad you're back, Jim.

INT. GYM - NIGHT

The team practices, laughing and encouraging each other. They push each other to be better, and Jim feels a sense of belonging that he hasn't experienced in years.

INT. GYM - WEEKS LATER

The team, now gelled and focused, competes in a local basketball tournament. They face challenges and setbacks, but they never give up on each other. They learn valuable lessons about friendship, perseverance, and the power of a team.

INT. GYM - FINAL GAME

In the final game, the team faces a formidable opponent, but they give it their all. They may not win the tournament, but they win something far more important: the respect and admiration of their opponents and the entire community.

EXT. GYM - AFTER THE GAME

The team gathers for a post-game chat. They talk about their experiences and their future plans. Jim looks around at his teammates, feeling a sense of pride and fulfillment.

JIM
(smiling)
We may not have won the tournament, but we've accomplished something much greater.

As the team leaves the gym, they look back, knowing that they've formed a bond that goes beyond the basketball court. They've found something truly valuable: a group of friends who will support and encourage each other, no matter what life throws their way.

THE END
